text:
rebecca.sales: Procurement at MedBridge wants a small assurance bundle to finalize the PO. Ask: SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope note, pen-test attestation (signed), a redacted staging network sketch, a short KMS/key-separation note, and confirmation on whether Dedicated + customer KMS changes price. Also asked if we can provide a SOC2 bridge letter if needed. Need a short reply for procurement.
matt.security: We can provide redacted SOC2 control excerpts and the ISO27001 scope statement. For pen-test we provide a one-page attestation signed by security lead (not full reports). We can also issue a SOC2 bridge letter on request but that requires audit team approval (3-5 business days).
jin.devops: For scanner access we can create ephemeral staging creds and a presigned upload path. If they want scoped vulnerability scanning against staging, we need to agree severity thresholds (e.g., open critical = stop) and an NDA addendum. Presigned uploads TTL 7d; naming conv `medbridge_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`.
omar.eng: I'll prepare a redacted network sketch that omits internal CIDRs and hostnames, and a one-page KMS separation note describing tenant keys + HSM usage. ETA 48h to sanitize.
rebecca.sales: Pricing blurb I can send? Procurement wants to know delta for Dedicated + customer-managed KMS.
matt.security: Short: Dedicated + customer KMS is treated as Enterprise-tier: platform fee + Dedicated commitment. Expect a one-time integration/SOW fee for KMS linkage; ballpark numbers to be confirmed by RevOps.
jin.devops: Operational impact: ~3 business days for KMS integration + smoke tests once Dedicated is provisioned. If they want VPC peering instead of presigned uploads, that's a separate network change and needs network review.
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.docx uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.docx (uploader: legal-bot).
rebecca.sales: Draft reply to procurement: "We can assemble a compact assurance packet (redacted SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope note, signed pen-test attestation, redacted staging network sketch, and KMS separation note) within ~3 business days. Pen-test attestation signature and any SOC2 bridge letter require additional approvals and may take up to 7 business days. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise-tier licensing (platform fee), a Dedicated commitment, and a one-time integration/SOW charge; we will provide exact pricing after RevOps review. For scanning access we can provide ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload link (7-day TTL); VPC peering or host-level scans require ops/legal signoff. We do not provide full penetration reports or raw internal logs without a formal NDA and legal approval."
matt.security: LGTM. Add: "If they request remediation attestations for any findings we can provide remediation summaries or POA statements"
rebecca.sales: Thanks — I'll send and mark pricing as provisional. Ping me if they push for bridge letter or raw report access.
